segment.source: Renders destinations as full-width rows, each with its title, a line of context and a trailing arrow, ruled between. Use it for: a long section index, a list of services, department or team pages, a support category with twenty answers, anywhere a card grid would waste the space. Prefer 'Page Card Menu' when a handful of destinations deserve their own cards, and 'Section Index' when the list runs to dozens and needs columns.
